name: parquet-go-portable-row-stream-checkpoints
instr:
parquet-go users need to suspend, persist, transfer, and resume any native or composed row traversal at its exact next observable row. Checkpoints for GenericBuffer, Buffer, RowBuffer, File, multi-row-group, and range row-group cursors must preserve each cursor's source identity, visible bounds, and exact logical position, including nested, typed, columnar, flattened, and child-group state. Streams that never use checkpoints must behave exactly as before.

Restored streams must be observationally equivalent to uninterrupted traversal, including nested rows, buffered output, source-read effects, ordering, deduplication, filtering, and transformation. Identical observable state must encode deterministically. Begin the envelope with a version byte, and copy supplied bytes when parsing so later mutation cannot affect the RowCheckpoint.

Make restoration atomic. Corrupt, truncated, unsupported, mismatched, or out-of-bounds state must return the corresponding CheckpointErrorKind without moving any participating cursor; a saved logical position beyond the receiving cursor's visible bounds is CheckpointOutOfBounds even when the source also differs. Preserve lifecycle, seeking, resetting, row accounting, io.EOF, terminal errors, ownership, and closed-state behavior. CopyRows and Scan must preserve uninterrupted ordering, ownership, and terminal outcomes.

The package github.com/parquet-go/parquet-go must expose the checkpoint API below.
